title: Scientific Digital Content Writer (SEO & AI-Optimized Content)
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**How will you make an impact?**


Join a team of digital content professionals dedicated to improving how scientists discover and engage with our products and solutions. As a **Scientific Digital Content Writer**, you will apply your scientific background and digital expertise to create clear, accurate, and high\-performing content that supports our customers across the buyer journey.


In this role, you will contribute to content strategy and execution by developing and optimizing web content using SEO and AI\-assisted methodologies. You will help ensure content is structured, discoverable, and aligned with user intent, while maintaining the highest standards of scientific accuracy and quality.


You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners, incorporate subject matter expertise, and use performance insights to continuously improve content effectiveness. This role requires a proactive, detail\-oriented individual who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and is motivated to learn and apply new tools and processes that drive efficiency and scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct keyword, topic, and intent research to identify opportunities to drive qualified traffic and engagement
* Develop, write, edit, and optimize scientific and marketing content for web and digital channels
* Apply SEO and AEO best practices to improve content discoverability and performance
* Evaluate existing content to identify duplication, gaps, and optimization opportunities; recommend and implement improvements
* Structure content using clear hierarchies, taxonomy, and internal linking to enhance user experience
* Participate in peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to support content quality and consistency
* Partner with SEO specialists, marketers, and digital teams to support aligned content strategies and initiatives
* Analyze content performance using analytics tools and apply insights to improve results
* Support the adoption of new content workflows, tools, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in biology or related life sciences field required
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred

**Experience**

* Experience in a life sciences field (e.g., research, R\&D, marketing, technical support, or related)
* Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills
* Experience writing scientific, technical, or marketing content for digital platforms preferred
* Experience working in a matrixed or global organization preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated understanding of SEO and emerging AEO principles, with the ability to apply best practices
* Experience using analytics and SEO tools (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush or similar)
* Knowledge of content strategy fundamentals, including information architecture, taxonomy, and user experience
* Comfort using AI\-enabled tools to enhance content creation, optimization, and workflow efficiency (no development required)
* Ability to evaluate and refine AI\-assisted outputs to ensure scientific accuracy and content quality
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with attention to detail
* Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross\-functional teams
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

VIDEO EDITOR
description:
**Bangalore \| Full time \| 1 to 4 Years Experience****English, Hindi \& Kannada** **If you can find the 5 seconds everyone needs to see, read on.**
You know when a 30 minute speech has **one moment worth watching?**
We’re looking for a **Video Editor** who can find it, cut it, and make people stop scrolling.
This isn’t just about knowing Premiere Pro.  

It’s about having the editing instinct to know **what stays, what goes, where the cut lands, when the music hits, and what keeps someone watching.**
You understand political storytelling, short form content, internet culture, and how content moves online.### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Edit political content for **Instagram Reels, YouTube, Facebook, X \& WhatsApp**
* Turn speeches, interviews, rallies, event footage, explainers and campaign videos into sharp, engaging, platform native content
* Watch long form footage and identify the strongest **hooks, moments and soundbites**
* Create cuts, transitions, subtitles, text animations, graphics, motion and visual effects that add to the story
* Get the **pace, context and visual language** right for every platform
* Adapt videos across different formats, durations, aspect ratios and languages
* Work closely with writers, graphic designers, photographers, strategists and campaign teams
* Handle multiple edits and priorities without letting quality or attention to detail slip
* Deliver high quality work on tight deadlines

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1 to 4 years** of experience as a Video Editor, preferably in political campaigns, digital media, advertising, news or other high volume content environments
* Strong command of **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* Knowledge of **DaVinci Resolve** is a plus
* Strong understanding of **Reels, Shorts, YouTube and social first video**
* Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, music, typography and visual composition
* Ability to take raw footage and figure out **what the story actually is**
* Ability to work quickly in a fast moving, deadline heavy environment
* Strong command of **English, Hindi \& Kannada**, including the political and cultural context behind the content
* Comfortable making creative decisions independently and adapting to changing priorities

### **WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* You’ve edited **political campaigns, news or public facing content** before
* Strong motion graphics and animation skills
* You understand **internet culture, memes and emerging formats**
* You have a sharp eye for **colour, sound design and visual storytelling**
* You can spot a killer clip before someone has to tell you it’s a killer clip
* Your portfolio demonstrates **social first editing instincts**, not just technical skills

### **THE SKILL WE’RE REALLY HIRING FOR**

**Editing judgement.**
Knowing that the 30 minute speech has **one line that changes everything.**
Knowing when to cut.
Knowing when to hold.
Knowing when the music should hit.
Knowing what makes someone watch till the end.
We’re hiring the person who knows:**“This is the moment.”**### **WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


This is not:**Import footage**  **make cuts**  **export**  **next.**
Politics moves fast. News breaks. Narratives change.
A clip that matters at **2 PM might be irrelevant by 6 PM.**
You’ll need to work with **speed, pressure, ambiguity and real time creative decisions.**### **WHY JOIN US?**


You’ll work at the intersection of **politics, video, culture and the internet.**
You’ll work alongside campaign strategists, writers, designers, social media teams and political professionals, creating content that is actually part of the conversation.**Your edits won’t just sit in a folder.****People will see them.**### **HOW TO APPLY**

**Don’t just send us your CV. Show us what you can do.**
Send your **CV \+ showreel/portfolio** to:**mailto:contact@designboxed.com****Bonus points for:*** 3 to 5 edits you’re genuinely proud of
* Political, news, advertising or digital campaign work
* Anything that demonstrates your **editing instinct, storytelling ability and creative judgement**

  

If you can take raw footage, find the story, and turn it into something people actually want to watch,**we want to see your work.**

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Technical Content Writer**

**Location:** Bangalore  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About INTERCERT

INTERCERT is a bootstrapped global organisation operating in the **Cybersecurity, Information Security, Governance, Risk \& Compliance, and Management Systems** space.

With over 17 years of industry experience, we work with organisations across industries and geographies to help them strengthen security, meet compliance requirements, and build trust.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Technical Content Writer** who can research, understand, and communicate complex topics across **cybersecurity, compliance, technology, and related domains**.

The role involves creating high\-quality, original, research\-driven content across long\-form and digital formats. The ideal candidate should be comfortable conducting in\-depth research and developing content that demonstrates genuine understanding and thought leadership.

Key Responsibilities

* Research and create **whitepapers, technical documents, case studies, SEO blogs, LinkedIn articles/posts, and other long\-form content**.
* Conduct independent research using credible sources and internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Translate complex cybersecurity, compliance, and technical concepts into clear, engaging, and easy\-to\-understand content.
* Develop content based on industry trends, regulations, customer challenges, market developments, and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with **SEO, Marketing, Design, and Technical/SME teams** to develop relevant and impactful content.
* Create SEO\-friendly content while maintaining depth, originality, readability, and technical accuracy.
* Work with internal SMEs to extract technical insights and convert them into high\-quality content.
* Edit, proofread, and fact\-check content to maintain accuracy, grammar, and consistency.
* Manage multiple content projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.

Requirements

* **3–4 years of professional experience** in technical writing, B2B content writing, technology content, or a similar role.
* Proven experience creating **long\-form content**, especially whitepapers, case studies, technical articles, industry reports, or thought\-leadership content.
* Strong research and information\-gathering skills with the ability to produce original, insight\-driven content.
* Excellent command of **written English, grammar, structure, and storytelling**.
* Ability to understand complex technical subjects and communicate them effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Good understanding of **SEO content principles, search intent, and content optimization**.
* Experience in **technology, cybersecurity, SaaS, IT, compliance, or B2B organisations** is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent editing, proofreading, and fact\-checking skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage multiple projects.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.

Key Skills

**Technical Writing \| Content Writing \| B2B Content \| Cybersecurity Content \| SEO Writing \| Whitepapers \| Case Studies \| Technical Articles \| Research \| Thought Leadership \| Editing \& Proofreading \| Content Strategy**

title: Property Documentation Executive
description:
Property Documentation Executive

**Company:** Zorba Estates  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience:** 0–4 Years  
**Qualification:** Any Degree  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**About Zorba Estates**

Zorba Estates is a Bengaluru\-based real estate company providing professional property solutions to **buyers, sellers, property owners, and investors**.

We support clients throughout the property transaction process, including **property documentation, client onboarding, document verification, coordination, legal support, and transaction follow\-ups**.

Our goal is to provide clients with a **smooth, transparent, and professional real estate experience** through proper documentation, timely communication, and effective coordination.

**Job Overview :**

We are looking for a **Property Documentation Executive** to manage property\-related documentation, client onboarding, document collection, legal coordination, client communication, and transaction follow\-ups.

The candidate will coordinate with **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal professionals, and internal teams** to ensure that all required documentation and transaction activities are completed accurately and on time.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
**Property Documentation**

* Prepare and assist in drafting **Sale Deeds, Agreements, and other property\-related documents**.
* Collect and organize property documents from owners, sellers, and buyers.
* Check documents for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Coordinate with the legal team for document review and corrections.
* Maintain proper physical and digital records of property documents.

**Client Onboarding**

* Handle onboarding of **buyers, sellers, and property owners**.
* Collect required client and property information.
* Verify that the required documents have been submitted.
* Explain documentation requirements and next steps to clients.
* Maintain updated client and property records.

**Client Communication**

* Communicate with clients through **phone calls, WhatsApp, and email**.
* Provide updates regarding documentation and transaction status.
* Respond to client queries and coordinate with the appropriate team.
* Send professional emails requesting documents, approvals, signatures, and other requirements.

**Buyer, Seller \& Owner Coordination**

* Coordinate between **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal teams, and internal teams**.
* Follow up for pending documents, signatures, approvals, and information.
* Coordinate document sharing and other transaction\-related activities.
* Ensure smooth communication between all parties.

**Legal Documentation Support**

* Assist with preliminary checking of property documents.
* Coordinate with legal professionals for **property document verification**.
* Identify missing information or documentation and escalate issues to the concerned team.
* Assist in preparing documents required for property transactions.

**Follow\-Up \& Record Management**

* Maintain regular follow\-ups with clients and stakeholders.
* Track pending documentation and transaction activities.
* Update CRM, Excel, or internal systems regularly.
* Maintain confidential and organized records of client and property documents.
* Ensure assigned documentation activities are completed within timelines.

**Requirements**

* Any Degree.
* 0–4 years of experience in **property documentation, real estate operations, documentation, CRM, administration, or client coordination**.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Word, MS Excel, Email, and CRM**.
* Ability to handle confidential documents professionally.
* Knowledge of property documentation and real estate transactions will be an advantage.

**Freshers with good communication, documentation, and coordination skills are welcome to apply.**

Key Skills

**Property Documentation \| Sale Deed Drafting \| Agreement Drafting \| Document Verification \| Client Onboarding \| Legal Coordination \| Client Communication \| Email Communication \| Follow\-Up \| CRM \| MS Excel \| Real Estate Operations**

Why Join Zorba Estates?

* Practical exposure to **real estate transactions and property documentation**.
* Opportunity to work with buyers, sellers, property owners, and legal professionals.
* Learn real estate documentation and transaction processes.
* Develop professional skills in client coordination and operations.
* Career growth opportunities within Zorba Estates.

**Apply Now**

If you are **detail\-oriented, organized, good at communication and follow\-ups**, and interested in building a career in real estate documentation, apply for the **Property Documentation Executive** position at Zorba Estates.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
